name: TelemetryEvent
description: Represents a single telemetry message emitted by a connected device, typically published over MQTT, CoAP, or HTTP to an IoT platform topic.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the telemetry event, often a UUID or platform-assigned id.

device_id.description: Identifier of the device that produced the telemetry event.

topic.description: MQTT topic, CoAP resource, or logical channel the event was published to.

timestamp.description: Time the device generated the event (device clock).

received_at.description: Time the platform received and ingested the event.

metric.description: Name of the metric or measurement carried by the event.

value.description: Numeric, boolean, string, or structured value reported by the device.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the reported value, when applicable.

quality.description: Quality indicator for the reported value.

qos.description: MQTT quality-of-service level used to publish the message.

metadata.description: Additional metadata attached to the event, such as firmware version, signal strength, or correlation ids.
